section_summary.extract_value: This section details the analytical methods used in the study, including calculating item response theory-based scores and evaluating psychometric properties of scales. It describes analyses to evaluate the relationship between creative achievement (CAQ total score) and cognitive ability (ICAR60 score) using linear and nonlinear models, and to test the threshold hypothesis. Additionally, it outlines linear regression analyses to examine how personality, vocational interests, and cognitive ability collectively account for variance in creative achievements, controlling for age and gender.
